The '''Kiamurr system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Likasha sector/Legends|Likasha sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and contained the planet [[Kiamurr]].
